pages.title: Computronium Singularity
pages.text: Computronium compacted into a single point, matter optimised for computation crushed together. It processes constantly and feels warm with the heat of erased bits. It seems to be thinking about something.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Computronium is matter arranged to compute as efficiently as possible. Compressing it in the Singularity Compactor gave a single point running more calculations than I can count.
